name: HC30c: Suppressed viral load
description:
Number of active ART patients whose 12-month anniversary after ART initiation falls within the reporting period, who had a viral load test during the same reporting period, and whose qualifying viral load result was suppressed.
The patient must have a documented art_start_date, the 12-month ART milestone must fall within :startDate and :endDate, the patient must be in HIV care and active on ART through an ART encounter during the reporting period or a return_visit_date beyond :endDate, and must have a VL episode within the reporting period with result_status = 'VALID', is_suppressed = 1, and is_unsuppressed = 0. The VL event date is determined using sample_collection_date, then viral_load_clinical_date, laboratory_result_date, and finally order_date.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

    /* 12-month ART milestone falls within reporting period */
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) >= :startDate
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
    < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

    /* HIV patient */
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
    WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
)

    /* Active on ART */
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
    WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
      AND (
        (
            a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
)

    /* Valid suppressed VL during the reporting period */
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
    WHERE v.patient_id = r.patient_id

      AND COALESCE(
                  v.sample_collection_date,
                  v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                  v.laboratory_result_date,
                  v.order_date
          ) >= :startDate

      AND COALESCE(
                  v.sample_collection_date,
                  v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                  v.laboratory_result_date,
                  v.order_date
          ) < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

        /* Must have a valid result */
      AND v.result_status = 'VALID'

        /* Suppressed only */
      AND v.is_suppressed = 1
      AND v.is_unsuppressed = 0
);
